reason: I forget pills at home all the time and I travel a lot, so one tear-and-go sachet in my bag actually fits how I live. At $24.99 I'd try one box, mostly because I'm scrolling TikTok at night anyway and magnesium for sleep keeps coming up.
objection: It's still two capsules every day, and it's a brand I've never heard of. I'm not sure it'll work for me, and I don't want to be stuck with a box I stop using.
would_change_my_mind: A smaller trial pack, like 7 sachets, so I could test it on a trip before paying for 30 days.
